blocks.text:
On arrival at Rio de Janeiro Airport, your guide will meet you. A private transfer will then take you to the hotel.

The city begins to reveal its geography along the way: granite slopes rise among residential neighbourhoods, palm trees line the road and glimpses of water appear between the buildings. Outside the airport, the air is warm and humid, carrying the scent of the ocean.

You will spend 4 nights at **Copacabana Palace, A Belmond Hotel**, in a **One Bedroom Double Suite** with a pool view and breakfast included. The hotel stands opposite Copacabana Beach.

After your flight, relax at the hotel or head out to the ocean. In the evening, lights come on in the hillside homes and the illuminated promenade stretches along the beach. A walk along Avenida Atlântica gives you a feel for Rio without a separate tour: the sound of the waves mingles with the city, cafés and restaurants are close by, and the ocean is just across the road from the hotel.
